NAME

md_docs_2deployment-notifications - Release and deployment notifications

.github/workflows/notify.yml sends the notifications for CLI releases and the three Vercel websites. Documentation deployments and container builds do not send notifications. Each caller supplies the subject, body, and job results; the shared workflow uses the existing SMTP secrets and dawidd6/action-send-mail action.

The existing SMTP_TO_EMAIL destination routes release notifications to Pushover. Keep that destination unchanged to retain its configured sound and delivery settings. The workflow does not set a sound or require a Pushover API token. See Pushover's email gateway documentation.

Notification jobs run after their deployment or publication job, including on failure, and include a link to the workflow run. A successful notification job confirms that the SMTP server accepted the email; device delivery and sound are controlled by Pushover and the recipient's device settings.
